title: 第三章 太公徐敢

content_zh:
那守着药炉的小孩子起身招呼：“乐郎君！”
这小孩子是韩约弟弟，韩氏也是丈夫早逝，拉扯着两个孩子长大。徐乐摆摆手：“小六，找你哥去，这儿有我。”
韩小六就差欢呼一声，三步并作两步就朝门外冲去，在门口才回头问了一句：“乐郎君这次带我不带？”
徐乐哼了一声：“你再长几岁罢！”
韩小六老大不乐意：“我也不差似哥哥什么，马上能开八斗弓，步下能开一石五！不管是刀盾还是长兵，乐郎君你尽管来考较我本事！”
老太公闭着眼睛冷冷开口：“你还差得远！”
韩小六敢跟徐乐耍赖，老太公开口却像老鼠见了猫，半点不敢则声，朝徐乐伸伸舌头就掉头出门。
老太公仍然闭着眼睛：“就不该教你们本事，一个个在闾中就是呆不住。要不是老头子卒中倒下来，你是不是还不肯回来？”
徐敢说话，已经有些含含糊糊，漏音缺字，正是中风之后的后遗症。但语气仍然威势不减。尤其睁开眼睛的时候，仍然威光棱棱，哪里像是一个寻常乡里的老人？
去年开始，马邑郡中接连起兵大战，或者救援雁门，或者与河东军合兵抵抗突厥南下。徐敢为他这个一手建立的徐家闾苦心孤诣操持一切，毕竟年岁高大了，突然中风倒下。
想及那时看着自家爷爷突然倒下的模样，徐乐都心有余悸。
对于徐乐而言，爷爷就是自己身后的撑天巨木。从小教养自己，从文到武。更不愿意让自己和一切危险的事情沾边。
自己想帮手什么，爷爷总是说自己还小，成家以后，等他两眼一闭了，再操持家事不迟。
就算自己叛逆年月，在和河东侠少厮混，最后闯出乐郎君这个名头。还不是靠着爷爷赚来的家当让自己结交朋友，爷爷教出来的一身本事折服众人？
徐乐不能说是太乖的孩子，也许是徐家血脉传下来的，性子锋锐乃是天生。什么事情打十几岁起就很有自己的主张，对爷爷将自己拘管在神武县这个小小天地里也感到百般无奈。对爷爷无微不至的关照也觉得有点喘不过气来。
可当爷爷倒下的时候，徐乐才感觉出来，爷爷这十八年来，已经尽力为自己撑持出一片还算安全的天地。
外面的天地，等闲事耳。要见识有的是时候，现在最要紧的是该自己照顾爷爷了，撑持着这个家熬过这个乱世岁月！
去年这个时候，徐乐还和一群侠少盘算着怎么绕开爷爷管束，寻个地方投军，然后在这世道上闯出一番功业出来。刘武周不也是乡间侠少出身，投于征高丽军中，最后回来做了恒安鹰扬府的鹰击郎将，开府建节，起居八座？
但是当爷爷倒下之后，这将近大半年来，徐乐在徐家闾绝足不出。只是帮忙操持家计。侠少飞扬跋扈，争雄斗狠之气近乎全消，多少朋友也断了往来。
老爷子数落自己，徐乐就当没听见，走到廊下取下药罐，倒到碗里，放在一边等稍稍凉些，这才对徐敢笑道：“这大半年我还不老实？为这个家可是操碎了心。”

徐敢哼了一声：“知道家计艰难了？以前手脚那么大，还不是老头子在后面撑持！”
发了一句火之后，徐敢又放低了声音：“真过不下去了？”
徐乐摇摇头：“过不下去了，家底干净，县里给闾中定的多是中户，咱们徐家更是上户。找人在主簿那里递了话，主簿说现在谁也违不了太守的令。闾中今年免行钱总计三十贯文上下，结束了县中的铺户，也不过就收回十二三贯文，村中还能凑起五六贯文。交不上就得应役，县中主簿还传了句话，说听闻过我的名字，这个时候早日投军才是正理，说不得就在王太守手下混个出身出来。”
徐敢默然，突然又开口道：“大业天子南走，一个个都起了别样心思。王仁恭还不是想在这乱局中分一杯羹！这些世家子，没一个好东西！”
徐乐摊手：“现在也只有回易这条路了，买北面达旦部族的马，结束店铺的钱全都换了粮食和解池的盐，到时候运马到善阳交割。”
徐敢不语，放在承平年月，这条回易道路都是千辛万苦，徐家闾初立的时候，老爷子就走过这条商路，获利虽然甚厚，但几次生死都系于一线。更不用说现在突厥大军已经迫于马邑之北，屡次南下骚扰，攻破雁门，和马邑兵河东兵连场大战！

content_en:
The child guarding the medicine stove stood up and greeted: "Le Langjun!"
This child is Han Yue's younger brother. Han's husband also died young and he raised his two children together. Xu Le waved his hand: "Xiao Liu, go find your brother, I'm here."
Han Xiaoliu almost cheered, and rushed out the door in three steps. At the door, he turned back and asked, "Le Langjun, will you take me with you this time?"
Xu Le snorted: "How much older can you be!"
The eldest brother, Han Xiaoliu, was not happy: "I'm not any worse than my brother. I can shoot eight bows immediately, and I can shoot five stones with one step! Whether it's a sword, shield or a long soldier, Mr. Lelang, you can come and test my skills!"
The old lady closed her eyes and said coldly: "You are still far away!"
Han Xiaoliu dared to cheat on Xu Le, but the old lady was like a mouse seeing a cat. She didn't dare to say anything. She stuck out her tongue at Xu Le and turned around and went out.
The old man still had his eyes closed: "I shouldn't have taught you my skills. You all just can't stay in the house. If the old man hadn't had a stroke and collapsed, wouldn't you have been willing to come back?"
Xu Gan's speech was already somewhat slurred, with missing sounds and missing words, which were the sequelae of a stroke. But the tone remains unabated. Especially when he opened his eyes, he still looked majestic. How could he look like an ordinary old man from the countryside?
Since last year, Mayi County has successively launched troops to fight, either to rescue Yanmen, or to join forces with the Hedong Army to resist the Turks' southward march. Xu Gan worked hard to take care of everything for the Xu family that he founded. After all, he was old and suddenly suffered a stroke and collapsed.
Xu Le was still frightened when he thought about watching his grandfather suddenly collapse.
For Xu Le, his grandfather is the giant tree supporting the sky behind him. Educate yourself from a young age, from literature to martial arts. I don't want to let myself get involved with anything dangerous.
When he wanted to help, my grandfather always said that he was still young and that after he got married, it wouldn't be too late for him to close his eyes before taking care of the family affairs.
Even if he was rebellious, he was hanging out with Hedong Xia Shao, and finally got the name Lelangjun. Didn't he rely on the wealth earned by his grandfather to make friends, and the skills his grandfather taught him impressed everyone?
Xu Le cannot be said to be a very well-behaved child. Perhaps it was passed down from the Xu family's bloodline, and he was born with a sharp temperament. Ever since I was a teenager, I have had my own opinions on everything, and I felt helpless that my grandfather kept me in this small world of Shenwu County. I also feel a little breathless about my grandpa’s meticulous care.
But when his grandfather fell, Xu Le felt that his grandfather had tried his best to maintain a relatively safe world for himself in the past eighteen years.
In the world outside, there is nothing to worry about. There is always time to realize that the most important thing now is to take care of grandpa by yourself and support the family through these troubled times!
This time last year, Xu Le and a group of young knights were thinking about how to get around his grandfather's control, find a place to join the army, and then make some achievements in this world. Wasn't Liu Wuzhou also born as a country knight, who joined the army to conquer Goryeo, and finally came back and became the general of the Yingyang Mansion in Heng'an, opening a mansion, building a festival, and living in eight houses?
But after his grandfather died, Xu Le was unable to leave the Xu family for nearly half a year. Just helping to run the family business. The young man became domineering, his fighting spirit was almost completely gone, and many of his friends were cut off.
The old man scolded him, but Xu Le pretended not to hear. He walked to the corridor, took out the medicine jar, poured it into a bowl, and put it aside to cool down a little. Then he smiled at Xu Gan and said, "I haven't been honest for the past six months? I have been worried about this family."
Xu Gan snorted: "Do you know that your family's financial situation is difficult? In the past, my hands and feet were so big, and it wasn't the old man who was supporting me from behind!"
After getting angry, Xu Gan lowered his voice again: "Can't you really survive?"
Xu Le shook his head: "I can't live any longer. My family is clean. Most of the people assigned to the middle household by the county are middle households, and our Xu family is even more of a top household. Find someone at the head register."After passing the message, the chief clerk said that no one can disobey the prefect's order now. Luzhong's free payment this year totaled about thirty guanwen, which ended the shop owners in the county and only recovered 12 or 3 guanwen. The village could still collect five or six guanwen. If you can't do it, you will have to join the army. The county chief registrar also sent a message, saying that he had heard of my name and it was only right to join the army as soon as possible at this time. There was no way he could just end up working under Governor Wang. "
Xu Gan was silent, then suddenly spoke again: "Emperor Daye left south, and everyone had other thoughts. Wang Rengong just wants to get a share of this mess! None of these aristocratic families are good! "
Xu Le spread his hands: "Now the only way is to return to the trade. Buy horses from the Dadan tribe in the north. All the money spent on closing the shop will be exchanged for grain and salt from the settlement pool. Then the horses will be transported to Shanyang for delivery. "
Xu Gan was silent. In the peaceful years, this trade road would have been a lot of hardships. When the Xu family was first established, the old man walked through this trade road. Although the profits were huge, life and death depended on it several times. Not to mention that the Turkic army is now forced to the north of Mayi, harassing southward many times, breaking through Yanmen, and fighting with Mayi soldiers and Hedong soldiers!
